description: Internal comparison using one agent model under three retrieval conditions
agent_model: Identity omitted; the underlying model was held constant across conditions

metric_definitions.overall_score_pct: Mean of the ten per-case rubric scores, including two negative controls
metric_definitions.fact_recall_pct: Rubric points recovered across 41 expected facts in eight answerable cases
metric_definitions.supported_answers: Answerable responses supported by retrieved source citations

caveats: One run per question; results were not replicated across random seeds.
The rubric was prewritten, but adjudication was manual and not blind.
The no-retrieval condition had no other access to the indexed sources.
The benchmark does not isolate the contribution of index cleanup, BM25, fusion, reranking, version filtering, or the improved tool contract.
